description: Returns a slide's speaker notes as plain text, plus the speakerNotesObjectId (the text shape on the slide's hidden notes page). The lookup fetches the slide's notes page internally, so you only need the slide's object id from list_slides. An empty string means the slide has no notes yet. Notes text is also searched by replace_text.

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

slide_object_id.description: The slide's object id (from list_slides) — not the notes page id.

name: get_speaker_notes
title: Get speaker notes
